description.intro: Master the area with FC Barcelona’s Nike goalkeeper’s short 2025/2026. With Dri-FIT fabric and striking green design, it offers breathability, lightness and professional style. Ideal for young goalkeepers who want to stand out under the sticks.
key_benefits: Fast drying: The Dri-FIT fabric quickly removes sweat.
Comfort in the goal: Optimised cut to move with agility.
Official design: Same style as that used by the goalkeepers of Barça.
Distinctive color: Vibrant green that stands out in the field.
